To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ALPase inhibitors affect the differentiation of the chick neural retina in vitro.
the development of the chick retina was affected by ALPase inhibitors.
ALPase inhibitors cause a delay in aggregate formation in the chick neural retina cultured in vitro and a considerable reduction in number of photoreceptors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the enzyme alkaline phosphatases (ALPases) during development of the chick retina.
the role of ALPase in the differentiation of neural cells.
the role of alkaline phosphotase (ALP) in the development of the retina.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ALPase is involved in the differentiation of photoreceptor, horizontal and Müller cells in the chick neural retina.
the ALPase activity in the chick retina is involved in the development of both the outer plexform layer and of photoreceptor differentiation.

ALPase plays a significant role as a marker enzyme for retinal cell differentiation and that ALPase inhibitors affect retinal cell differentiation, particularly photoreceptor cell differentiation, in vitro.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ALPase may have a role in the formation of synaptic contacts and in the differentiation of photoreceptors.
ALPase may be involved in retinal cell development by regulating the expression of cell adhesion molecules.
ALPase may play an important role in retinal development and its inhibition results in developmental disturbances of the outer plectiform layer and photoreceptor cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of alkaline phosphates in the retina is not a mere epiphenomenon, but rather that these phosphatases are involved in cell differentiation and in synaptogenesis.
ALPase inhibitors can affect retinal development and that this effect is mediated via a direct action on retinal cells.
ALPase inhibitors may be useful for the treatment of some retinal degenerations.
